entry.name: jit.gl.render
entry.description: Use jit.gl.render to render Jitter OpenGL objects to a rendering destination. jit.gl.render drives the rendering of 3D graphics, setting up and invoking the drawing of each frame. jit.gl.render can draw to jit.window and jit.pwindow.
